question: Which hidden grove will your wanderlust lead you to?
intro_environment: A vast, ancient forest stretches to the horizon, its towering emerald canopy interspersed with golden sunbeams. The mist rolls softly over moss-covered stone paths, hinting at forgotten secrets.
intro_couple_action: The couple strolls along a narrow, winding trail, their silhouettes small against the grand trees, eyes wide with wonder.

choices.title: Sunlit Meadow
choices.description: A wide, open meadow bathed in early morning light, dotted with wildflowers and a solitary stone archway half buried in vines.
choices.composition: Wide panoramic with a central archway framing the foreground, leading the eye into the distance.
choices.dominant_palette: Earthy greens, soft golds, and pale sky blues
choices.couple_action: The couple pauses beside the archway, sharing a quiet laugh as they trace the carvings.

choices.title: Bioluminescent Thicket
choices.description: A dense thicket of towering ferns and luminous fungi, their gentle glow lighting a hidden path that curls through the undergrowth.
choices.composition: Vertical split with the glow illuminating the left side, while the right side remains shrouded in shadow.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep greens, vibrant teal, and soft amber highlights
choices.couple_action: The couple moves cautiously, their lanterns flickering, as they navigate the glowing vines.

choices.title: Mist-Cliff Promontory
choices.description: A towering cliff overlooking a mist-laden sea, with a narrow ledge that offers a breathtaking view of the horizon.
choices.composition: High-angle shot capturing the cliff's sheer drop and the mist curling at its base.
choices.dominant_palette: Cool greys, muted blues, and seafoam green
choices.couple_action: The couple stands on the ledge, hand in hand, watching the waves crash below.

choices.title: Starlit Cascades
choices.description: A cascading waterfall that pours into a crystal-clear pool, with star-like reflections dancing on the water's surface during twilight.
choices.composition: Centered perspective with the waterfall as the focal point, leading the eye toward the tranquil pool.
choices.dominant_palette: Deep blues, silver accents, and midnight purples
choices.couple_action: The couple sits on a mossy rock, dipping their toes in the pool while stargazing.
